item.title: New Alabama program allows veterans to teach without degree
item.description: DOTHAN, Ala. (WDHN) -- Governor Kay Ivey signed a bill Tuesday that allows eligible veterans to become teachers for a five-year period without needing a college degree. On March 3, Senate Bill 149 was signed into law, creating a temporary teaching certificate for Alabama military veterans who want to become teachers -- no degree necessary. [...]
